constraints: Each talk is scheduled exactly once, in one room and one slot; at most one talk per room per slot.
A room's capacity must be >= the talk's audience.
A speaker cannot give two talks in the same slot.
A speaker cannot give talks in two consecutive slots (10:00 and 11:00 are consecutive; 11:00 and 13:00 are consecutive).
Talks sharing an audience must not be in the same slot: (T1,T5), (T1,T8), (T5,T8), (T2,T7), (T3,T9), (T4,T10).
T5 must be strictly before T1. T4 must be strictly before T2. T9 must be strictly after T6.
